summary: Iteration 137 - Staff Onboarding Gate fully tested. All backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. Non-activated staff users see blocking onboarding gate with 4-tab flow (passport, address, HMRC, contract). Account activates after completing all tasks. PendingLegalDocsGate correctly skips when user.is_activated===false.

tests: Register housekeeper sets is_activated=false (if role valid)
GET /staff-onboarding/me auto-creates onboarding doc if missing
Returns progress object with tasks, done, total, pct, complete
Returns hmrc_statements dict with A, B, C statements
Auto-syncs contract_signed from staff_contracts when status=signed
Rejects invalid file types with 400 error
Rejects invalid statement (must be A, B, or C)
POST /staff-onboarding/complete returns 400 with 'Incomplete tasks: ...' when any task false
When all tasks true, sets users.is_activated=true
GET /staff-onboarding/list returns list of onboardings (admin/manager only)
Non-admin users get 403 on admin endpoints
Shows 4 tabs: ID/Passport, Address Proof, HMRC Checklist, Employment Contract
Progress bar reflects real task completion
Passport/address tabs have upload buttons and file inputs
HMRC form has all required fields with data-testid attributes
Contract tab shows emerald success state when signed, amber awaiting state when not
Complete button only appears when all 4 tasks done
Clicking complete activates account and dismisses gate
PendingLegalDocsGate (z-[100]) does NOT fire while user.is_activated===false
After activation, PendingLegalDocsGate fires for pending legal docs

critical_code_review_comments: StaffOnboardingGate correctly uses user.is_activated===false check to show gate
Backend staff_onboarding.py uses current_user.get('id') which relies on user doc having 'id' field (UUID)
Contract auto-sync works by checking staff_contracts for matching staff_email with status=signed
HMRC validation correctly checks NI number length (9 chars) and statement (A/B/C)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 137 added Staff Onboarding Gate - a blocking gate for non-activated staff users. Gate shows 4-tab flow: passport upload, address proof upload, HMRC starter checklist form, and employment contract status. Contract auto-syncs from staff_contracts collection. After completing all 4 tasks, user clicks 'Activate my account' which sets is_activated=true. PendingLegalDocsGate correctly waits until after onboarding (checks user.is_activated===false to skip). Test user sarah@hotel.test can be reset by setting is_activated=false and deleting staff_onboarding record.

mocked_apis_list: Document storage is local filesystem only (/app/backend/uploads/onboarding)
HMRC form data stored in MongoDB only - not transmitted to HMRC RTI
No virus scanning or OCR on uploaded documents
